# CertShield

> CertShield is vendor insurance compliance software for US property managers and contractors. Its AI reads certificates of insurance (ACORD forms), verifies coverage limits, additional-insured endorsements, and expiration dates against each company's requirements, then automatically chases vendors and their insurance agents for renewals by email (English and Spanish). Every verdict is human-reviewed before publishing, with audit-ready document trails. CertShield replaces spreadsheet-based COI tracking at SMB pricing, from $99/month. Founded in 2026.

## Who it's for

- US property management companies (20–2,000 units)
- Small/mid general contractors (10–100 subcontractors)

## Pricing

- Starter: $99/mo — 25 vendors
- Pro: $249/mo — 100 vendors
- Business: $499/mo — unlimited vendors
- No annual lock-in. Free 3-cert audit available.

## Claims

We claim: AI COI verification including endorsement checks, email auto-chasing EN/ES, SMS (TCPA opt-in), vendor portal, agent confirmations, fraud risk signals, carrier AM Best checks, API/webhooks, audit/litigation packs.

We do not claim: guaranteed compliance, automatic mid-term cancellation detection, or "always accurate."
